questions.question: Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: hazardous
Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: supple
questions.explanation: Supple means flexible and able to bend easily.

questions.question: Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: bubbly
questions.explanation: Bubbly can mean lively and enthusiastic; effervescent has the same meaning.

questions.question: Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: emblem
questions.explanation: An emblem is a badge or symbol that represents something.

questions.question: Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: elongate
questions.explanation: To elongate something means to make it longer.

questions.question: Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: venomous
questions.explanation: Venomous means able to inject venom, so poisonous is the closest option.

questions.question: Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: renovate
questions.explanation: To renovate means to repair and improve a building or object.

questions.question: Select the word that has the same or similar meaning to the word on the left: initiate
questions.explanation: To initiate something means to start it.

questions.question: What is another word for ‘garish’ (line 23)?
questions.explanation: Garish means unpleasantly bright or showy; lurid is the closest match.

questions.question:
‘…to commemorate the fabled run…’ (line 2)
Which of the following is closest in meaning to ‘commemorate’?
questions.explanation: To commemorate something means to remember and honour it.
